title: little bleu
meta_description: Indulge in comfort and style at this charming vacation rental, complete with bikes and a 6-seater golf cart for effortless trips to the beach or nearby dining, shopping, and entertainment. Relax by the community pool or unwind on the back deck, equipped with an outdoor grill and plenty of seating. The open-concept living area and fully stocked kitchen set the stage for
description_expanded: AboutProperty Highlights: ● 6-seater golf cart ● Bikes! ● Community pool ● Back deck with outdoor grill and ample furniture ● Fully stocked kitchen ● Open concept living area ● Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella ● Free wifi ● Close to dining, shopping, and entertainment ● Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom. Escape to Little Bleu, a breathtaking coastal retreat that perfectly embodies the charm of Inlet Beach along Scenic 30A. This prime location offers easy access to pristine beaches, while also placing you near the boutiques, delightful dining options, and lively entertainment of 30A Avenue, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach, ensuring you experience the very best of the Gulf Coast. Little Bleu’s outdoor spaces invite relaxation and enjoying the soothing coastal breezes. Step onto spacious porches, perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply taking in the neighborhood’s energy. The fenced yard offers privacy and is ideal for cherished moments with loved ones. Evenings around the fire pit provide the opportunity to toast marshmallows, savor nightcaps, and gaze at the stars. With a 6-seater golf cart provided and bikes, exploring the neighborhood and cruising to the beach or other nearby communities becomes a seamless adventure. This beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home is situated in the highly desirable Grande Pointe neighborhood, just minutes from the sugar-white sands of Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access. Inside, Little Bleu greets you with an airy, open-concept design that blends modern comfort with coastal charm. The spacious living area offers the perfect spot to gather after a beach day or exploration, while an additional living room with two twin beds provides flexible space for families and groups. The well-designed kitchen features premium appliances, making it effortless to prepare anything from a quick breakfast to an elaborate dinner. This culinary haven caters to all your dining needs, whether it’s a casual morning meal or a memorable family feast. Throughout the home, vibrant coastal charm is highlighted by unique artwork celebrating the beauty of the beach, creating warmth and relaxation in every room. The primary suite serves as a private sanctuary, complete with an ensuite bath featuring a luxurious walk-in shower and a workspace and lounge area. Additional bedrooms include one with twin beds and another with a queen bed and crib, offering comfort for families with little ones or groups of friends. For extended stays, a convenient laundry room lets you pack light and enjoy the comforts of home. Whether you’re here to soak up the beauty of 30A’s stunning beaches, savor the local cuisine, or unwind in the luxurious comfort of Little Bleu, this Inlet Beach retreat ensures unforgettable memories and ultimate relaxation.
